svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Section through a muqarnas vault with the far half seen from below: rings of small concave cells, each tier corbelled inward over the one beneath and staggered against it, step up from the square room to a small crowning dome; the cut at the front shows the true profile. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
svg.text: SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of
this form; no external drawing reproduced.
